1976. Browser Back Button Using Stack

60

Medium

Problem Statement

A web browser maintains a history of visited pages using a stack. Given a sequence of visited page IDs, print the page that will be displayed after pressing the Back button once.

Description

A user visits N web pages. The most recently visited page is at the top of the stack. Simulate one Back operation by removing the current page and displaying the previous page.

If only one page exists, print "No Previous Page".
